471PRICE-TIME SQUARE NOW
459time square due, price not on a level
304time square in the next 1–5 bars
526sideways (skipped)

Same rules as the TradingView indicator: a square is a time square (range/S or 0.5T–2T from the start of the current move, within ±10.0% of T) while price sits on a level — a quarter of the DNA range, the 1x1 angle, a 0.5–2R target or a swing angle — not while the DNA swing is still extending and not when the market is sideways. "Tools" counts how many of those levels agree; "Rules work" is the indicator's history test on the stock's own swings (0–3). Settings: ATR zigzag (significant swings), reversal 3.0×ATR · time tolerance 10.0% of T · provisional on · sideways filter on · angle scale auto (150 bars). Expect a turn, but enter only on a reversal candle with the stop beyond its extreme.
